name: Pilot Citizens' Assembly of Auroville
content: Problems and Purpose Participants asked to respond to remit to "develop a water vision for Auroville and recommendations for its effective implementation." Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities SAIIER (Sri Aurobindo International Institute of Educational Research) funded this initiative. Participant Recruitment and Selection Methods and Tools UsedCitizens' assemblyWhat Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation Influence, Outcomes, and Effects This initiative led to the creation of a Water Vision, which included 57 ideas for how to implement it.
